meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写代码前先把需求问透,产出一份能直接开工的完整方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常因需求没聊清就动手,结果反复返工。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague coding request into a clear, ready-to-start work plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if unclear requirements keep turning into rework after you start coding.

howto.what: Claude 会以 Prometheus 的身份充当规划顾问：先只读探索代码库，只在探索解答不了的分叉上问你，等你明确同意后写出一份决策完整、执行者无需再被采访的工作计划。它从不修改产品代码，也不动手实现。
howto.when: 只在你本人明确要求时启动，例如说出 ulw-plan、/skill:ulw-plan，或用自己话要求在写代码前先做计划。单独的 ulw 运行或代理自身的路由决定不算请求。

say.text: ulw-plan：给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先探索、只问必需分叉，再出计划等你批准

say.text: 帮我规划一下把认证模块重构一遍
say.note: 意图模糊时自动采用最佳实践默认值并做研究

say.text: 这个要高精度计划，请认真审
say.note: 触发 momus 与 Codex CLI 的双重高精度评审

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Prometheus, a planning consultant: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only about forks exploration cannot settle, waits for your explicit okay, then writes one decision-complete work plan.
howto.when_en: Starts only on your explicit request - saying ulw-plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. A bare ulw run or agent-side routing does not count.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Explores, asks real forks, drafts a plan for your approval

say_en.text: Plan a refactor of the auth module for me
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent: adopts best-practice defaults and researches

say_en.text: This needs high accuracy, review it carefully
say_en.note: Triggers momus plus Codex CLI high-accuracy review
